name: Pull-Up Hold
summary: A static bodyweight exercise holding a flexed position on a pull-up bar to build isometric pulling strength and endurance.

setup: Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Step off a box or jump up so your chin clears the bar, with your chest close to hand height.
steps: Retract and depress your shoulder blades, actively pulling your elbows down and back.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to prevent swinging.
Hold this flexed position steadily for the designated time.
Lower yourself in a controlled manner back to the ground or box when finished.
instructions.breathing: Breathe continuously and smoothly into your belly without letting tension out of your upper back.
cues: Drive elbows into your back pockets
Stay tight from shoulders to toes

common_faults.fault: Allowing shoulders to shrug up toward the ears as fatigue sets in.
common_faults.correction: Actively depress your scapulae by pulling your shoulders down away from your ears.

common_faults.fault: Kicking or excessively swinging the lower body.
common_faults.correction: Brace your abdominals and maintain a tight hollow-body or straight-body position.

precautions: Use a stable box or step to reach the bar safely rather than attempting an uncontrolled jump.
